description: This file defines the AutoFitTextureView class, a custom Android TextureView that can be adjusted to a specific aspect ratio, commonly used in camera or video applications to ensure the view maintains a desired width-to-height ratio.

classes.name: AutoFitTextureView
classes.description: A custom TextureView that maintains a specific aspect ratio for consistent display, especially useful in camera preview implementations.

methods.name: setAspectRatio
methods.description: Sets the aspect ratio for the view by specifying width and height parameters. Updates internal ratio variables and requests layout update.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Overrides the measurement process to adjust the view's dimensions based on the specified aspect ratio.
